new_nodes.name: Uniform random coloring
new_nodes.function_signature: (Combinatorial structure, Palette of c colors) -> (Expected bad-event count, Existence of good coloring)
new_nodes.description: Color each element independently and uniformly at random from a palette, then compute expected bad events to prove existence of a good coloring.

new_nodes.name: Property B existence for uniform hypergraphs
new_nodes.description: Every n-uniform hypergraph with fewer than 2^{n-1} edges is 2-colorable (has Property B).

new_nodes.name: Max-cut probabilistic lower bound
new_nodes.description: Every graph on m edges has a bipartite subgraph (cut) with at least m/2 edges.

new_nodes.name: Sum-free subset probabilistic bound
new_nodes.description: Every set of n nonzero integers contains a sum-free subset of size greater than n/3.

new_nodes.name: Property B of a hypergraph
new_nodes.description: A hypergraph has Property B if its vertex set can be 2-colored so that no edge is monochromatic.

new_nodes.name: Linearity of expectation technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Random variable as sum of indicators) -> (E[X] = sum E[X_i], Existence bound via first moment)
new_nodes.description: Decompose a random variable as a sum of indicator random variables, compute E[X] = sum E[X_i] without requiring independence, then apply the first moment method.

new_nodes.name: Tournament dominating set bound
new_nodes.description: Every tournament on n players has a dominating set of size at most ceil(log_2 n) + 1.

new_nodes.name: Balancing vectors bound
new_nodes.description: Given n vectors v_1,...,v_n in R^n with ||v_i||_2 <= 1, there exist signs epsilon_i in {+1,-1} with ||sum epsilon_i v_i||_infinity <= sqrt(2 ln(2n)).

new_nodes.name: Unbalancing lights
new_nodes.description: For any n x n matrix A with entries in {+1,-1}, there exist epsilon in {+/-1}^n with ||A epsilon||_infinity >= sqrt(n * 2/pi).

new_nodes.name: Independence number greedy-expectation bound
new_nodes.description: For any graph G, alpha(G) >= sum_{v in V} 1/(d(v)+1) where d(v) is the degree of vertex v.

new_nodes.name: Crossing number inequality
new_nodes.description: For any graph with m >= 4n edges, the crossing number satisfies cr(G) >= m^3/(64n^2).

new_nodes.name: Ramsey lower bound via alteration
new_nodes.description: R(k,k) >= (1+o(1))(k/(e*sqrt(2))) * 2^{k/2}, improving the basic probabilistic bound by alteration.

new_nodes.name: Shearer's bound for triangle-free graphs
new_nodes.description: Every triangle-free d-regular graph on n vertices satisfies alpha(G) >= Omega(sqrt(n log n / d)).

new_nodes.name: Independent transversal via alteration
new_nodes.description: If each partition class has size >= 2*Delta(G), then an independent transversal exists.

new_nodes.name: Paley-Zygmund inequality
new_nodes.description: For a nonnegative random variable X, Pr[X > 0] >= (E[X])^2 / E[X^2].

new_nodes.name: Paley graph properties
new_nodes.description: The Paley graph P(q) on F_q has no clique or independent set of size exceeding (1+o(1)) log_2 q.

new_nodes.name: Variance
new_nodes.description: Var[X] = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2, measuring the expected squared deviation of X from its mean.

new_nodes.name: Lovasz Local Lemma technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Bad events {A_i}, Dependency graph G) -> (Pr[cap A_i^c] > 0, Existence of object avoiding all bad events)
new_nodes.description: Define bad events, construct a dependency graph, verify the LLL condition ep(d+1) <= 1 (symmetric) or x_i weights (general), then conclude all bad events can be simultaneously avoided.

new_nodes.name: Lovasz Local Lemma (symmetric form)
new_nodes.description: If each event A_i has Pr[A_i] <= p and is dependent on at most d others, and ep(d+1) <= 1, then Pr[intersection of all A_i^c] > 0.

new_nodes.name: Lopsided Lovasz Local Lemma
new_nodes.description: The LLL holds under the weaker condition of a lopsidependency graph, where Pr[A_i | intersection of A_j^c for j in S] <= Pr[A_i] for non-neighbors S.

new_nodes.name: Moser-Tardos algorithmic LLL
new_nodes.description: The Moser-Tardos resampling algorithm finds a satisfying assignment in expected O(sum x_i/(1-x_i)) steps under the LLL conditions.

new_nodes.name: k-SAT LLL bound
new_nodes.description: A k-CNF formula in which each clause shares variables with at most 2^k/e - 1 other clauses is satisfiable.

new_nodes.name: Latin transversal via LLL
new_nodes.description: An n x n array where each symbol appears at most n/(4e) times has a Latin transversal.

new_nodes.name: Lopsidependency graph
new_nodes.description: A graph on events where Pr[A_i | intersection of A_j^c for j in S] <= Pr[A_i] for every set S of non-neighbors of i.

new_nodes.name: FKG inequality
new_nodes.description: On a finite distributive lattice with a log-supermodular measure mu, for increasing functions f and g: E[fg] >= E[f]E[g].

new_nodes.name: Four functions theorem (Ahlswede-Daykin)
new_nodes.description: If alpha, beta, gamma, delta are nonneg functions on a finite lattice with alpha(a)beta(b) <= gamma(a v b)delta(a ^ b) for all a,b, then (sum alpha)(sum beta) <= (sum gamma)(sum delta).

new_nodes.name: Reimer inequality (BK inequality)
new_nodes.description: For events A, B on {0,1}^n, Pr[A box B] <= Pr[A]*Pr[B], where A box B denotes disjoint occurrence. Proved by Reimer, resolving the van den Berg-Kesten conjecture.

new_nodes.name: Increasing event
new_nodes.description: An event A in {0,1}^n such that omega in A and omega <= omega' coordinatewise implies omega' in A.

new_nodes.name: Disjoint occurrence (box product)
new_nodes.description: A box B is the event that disjoint witness sets of coordinates certify A and B simultaneously.

new_nodes.name: Azuma-Hoeffding technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Function f, Sequential exposure of variables) -> (Doob martingale, Bounded differences, Exponential tail bound)
new_nodes.description: Construct a Doob martingale by sequential exposure, verify bounded-difference conditions, then apply Azuma-Hoeffding to obtain exponential concentration.

new_nodes.name: Vertex exposure martingale
new_nodes.function_signature: (Graph parameter f, G(n,p)) -> (Doob martingale via vertex-by-vertex exposure, Concentration bound)
new_nodes.description: Expose vertices of G(n,p) one by one; the resulting Doob martingale gives concentration for Lipschitz graph parameters.

new_nodes.name: Edge exposure martingale
new_nodes.function_signature: (Graph parameter f, G(n,p)) -> (Doob martingale via edge-by-edge exposure, Tighter concentration bound)
new_nodes.description: Expose potential edges of G(n,p) one by one; yields tighter concentration than vertex exposure when the parameter is edge-Lipschitz.

new_nodes.name: Chromatic number concentration
new_nodes.description: The chromatic number chi(G(n,1/2)) is concentrated in an interval of width O(sqrt(n)).

new_nodes.name: Kim-Vu polynomial concentration
new_nodes.description: Tight concentration bounds for multilinear polynomials of independent {0,1} random variables.

new_nodes.name: Doob martingale (combinatorial)
new_nodes.description: M_i = E[f | F_i] defines a martingale by sequential exposure of random variables; the fundamental tool for applying martingale concentration in combinatorics.

new_nodes.name: Lipschitz function on product space
new_nodes.description: A function f on a product space is c-Lipschitz if changing any single coordinate changes f by at most c.

new_nodes.name: Stein-Chen Poisson approximation
new_nodes.function_signature: (Sum of weakly dependent indicators) -> (Poisson approximation, Explicit TV distance bound)
new_nodes.description: Approximate the distribution of a sum of weakly dependent indicator random variables by a Poisson distribution, with explicit total-variation bounds.

new_nodes.name: Triangle threshold in G(n,p)
new_nodes.description: The threshold for triangles in G(n,p) is p = n^{-1}; when p = c/n the number of triangles converges in distribution to Poisson(c^3/6).

new_nodes.name: Bonferroni inequalities
new_nodes.description: Truncated inclusion-exclusion sums yield alternating upper and lower bounds for Pr[union of A_i].

new_nodes.name: Expander mixing technique
new_nodes.function_signature: ((n,d,lambda)-graph, Vertex subsets S,T) -> (Edge count approximation, Pseudo-random bound)
new_nodes.description: Use the spectral gap of a regular graph to show that edge distribution between vertex subsets approximates that of a random graph.

new_nodes.name: Paley graph pseudo-randomness
new_nodes.description: The Paley graph is an (n, (n-1)/2, O(sqrt(n)))-graph, exhibiting strong pseudo-random properties.

new_nodes.name: (n,d,lambda)-graph
new_nodes.description: A d-regular graph on n vertices whose second-largest eigenvalue (in absolute value) of the adjacency matrix is at most lambda.

new_nodes.name: Erdos-Renyi G(n,m) model
new_nodes.description: A uniform random graph on n labelled vertices with exactly m edges.

new_nodes.name: Katona's cyclic permutation proof of EKR
new_nodes.description: Katona's elegant proof of the Erdos-Ko-Rado theorem using counting over cyclic permutations and arcs.

new_nodes.name: Lovasz theta sandwich theorem
new_nodes.description: For any graph G, alpha(G) <= theta(G) <= chi_bar(G), sandwiching the Lovasz theta function between the independence number and the fractional chromatic number.

new_nodes.name: Shannon capacity of C_5
new_nodes.description: The Shannon capacity of the 5-cycle is Theta(C_5) = sqrt(5), determined by Lovasz via the theta function.

new_nodes.name: Ramsey bound via Lovasz theta function
new_nodes.description: R(3,k) >= Omega(k^2/log^2 k), obtained using the Lovasz theta function.

new_nodes.name: Shannon capacity of a graph
new_nodes.description: Theta(G) = lim_{n->inf} (alpha(G^{box n}))^{1/n}, the zero-error capacity of a noisy channel with confusability graph G.

new_nodes.name: Lovasz theta function
new_nodes.description: An SDP-computable graph parameter theta(G) satisfying alpha(G) <= theta(G) <= chi_bar(G).

new_nodes.name: Partial coloring method
new_nodes.function_signature: (Set system, Pigeonhole/entropy argument) -> (Partial coloring with low discrepancy, Iteration to full coloring)
new_nodes.description: Find a partial coloring of low discrepancy by pigeonhole or entropy arguments, then iterate to color all elements.

new_nodes.name: Beck-Fiala technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Set system with bounded degree t) -> (Coloring with discrepancy <= 2t-2)
new_nodes.description: Fix colors of elements appearing in few active sets by a dimension/linear algebra argument, iterating until all elements are colored.

new_nodes.name: Partial coloring lemma
new_nodes.description: There exists a coloring with at least n/2 nonzero entries and discrepancy O(sqrt(n)) for any n sets on n elements.

new_nodes.name: Discrepancy of arithmetic progressions
new_nodes.description: The discrepancy of the set system of arithmetic progressions in [n] is Theta(n^{1/4}).

new_nodes.name: Combinatorial discrepancy
new_nodes.description: disc(S) = min_{chi: X -> {-1,+1}} max_{S in S} |sum_{x in S} chi(x)|, the minimum worst-case imbalance over all 2-colorings.

new_nodes.name: Method of conditional expectations
new_nodes.function_signature: (Probabilistic existence argument with E[X]) -> (Deterministic sequential construction achieving E[X] bound)
new_nodes.description: Sequentially set each random variable to the value that keeps the conditional expectation favorable, derandomizing a probabilistic proof.

new_nodes.name: Pairwise independence derandomization
new_nodes.function_signature: (Probabilistic argument using only 1st/2nd moments) -> (Deterministic construction with O(log n) random bits)
new_nodes.description: Replace full independence with pairwise independence, preserving first and second moment arguments while reducing randomness.

new_nodes.name: k-wise independence derandomization
new_nodes.function_signature: (Probabilistic argument using k-th moments) -> (Deterministic construction with O(k log n) bits)
new_nodes.description: Use k-wise independent random variables constructible from O(k log n) random bits to derandomize arguments depending on k-th moments.

new_nodes.name: Derandomized Ramsey lower bound
new_nodes.description: Constructive proof that R(k,k) >= 2^{k/2} via the method of conditional expectations.

new_nodes.name: Deterministic max-cut algorithm
new_nodes.description: A polynomial-time greedy algorithm produces a cut with at least m/2 edges, derandomizing the probabilistic max-cut bound.

new_nodes.name: k-wise independent random variables
new_nodes.description: A collection of random variables where every subset of size at most k is mutually independent.

new_nodes.name: Pairwise independent random variables
new_nodes.description: Random variables satisfying E[X_i X_j] = E[X_i]E[X_j] for all i != j, i.e., 2-wise independence.

new_nodes.name: Graph property testing
new_nodes.function_signature: (Graph property, Error parameter epsilon) -> (Constant-query randomized test)
new_nodes.description: Test a graph property by querying a random constant-size induced subgraph and checking the property on it.

new_nodes.name: Testability of hereditary graph properties
new_nodes.description: Every hereditary graph property is testable with a constant number of queries (depending only on epsilon).

new_nodes.name: Triangle removal lemma
new_nodes.description: A graph with at most delta*n^3 triangles can be made triangle-free by removing at most epsilon*n^2 edges.

new_nodes.name: Ruzsa-Szemeredi (6,3)-theorem
new_nodes.description: A graph on n vertices in which every edge belongs to exactly one triangle has o(n^2) edges.

new_nodes.name: Chernoff bound technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Sum of independent RVs, Tail parameter t) -> (Exponential tail bound via MGF optimization)
new_nodes.description: Bound tail probabilities by optimizing the exponential moment E[exp(lambda X)] over lambda (exponential tilting / Cramér method).

new_nodes.name: Janson inequality technique
new_nodes.function_signature: (Dependent indicators {I_A}, Pairwise dependency measure Delta) -> (Lower tail bound Pr[X=0])
new_nodes.description: Control pairwise correlations among dependent indicators to obtain lower tail bounds, bounding Pr[X=0] <= exp(-mu + Delta/2).

new_nodes.name: Janson extended inequality
new_nodes.description: Pr[X=0] <= exp(-mu^2/(2 Delta)) when the dependency measure Delta >= mu, giving a stronger bound in the high-dependency regime.

new_nodes.name: Subgraph count concentration
new_nodes.description: The number of copies of a fixed subgraph H in G(n,p) is concentrated around its expectation.

new_nodes.name: Weierstrass product inequality
new_nodes.description: For x_i in [0,1]: prod_{i}(1 - x_i) >= 1 - sum_{i} x_i, a basic inequality used in probabilistic lower bounds.

new_nodes.name: Entropy method in combinatorics
new_nodes.function_signature: (Combinatorial counting problem) -> (Counting bound via subadditivity, chain rule, max-entropy principle)
new_nodes.description: Use subadditivity of Shannon entropy, the chain rule, and the maximum entropy principle to derive combinatorial counting and discrepancy bounds.

new_nodes.name: Shearer's entropy lemma
new_nodes.description: If each coordinate is covered at least t times by sets A_1,...,A_m, then t*H(X) <= sum_{i} H(X_{A_i}).

new_nodes.name: Bregman's theorem (permanent bound)
new_nodes.description: For a 0-1 matrix A with row sums r_1,...,r_n, the permanent satisfies perm(A) <= prod_{i} (r_i!)^{1/r_i}.

new_nodes.name: Kahn-Zhao theorem on independent sets
new_nodes.description: The number of independent sets in a d-regular bipartite graph on 2n vertices is at most (2^{d+1} - 1)^{n/d}, with equality for a disjoint union of K_{d,d}.

new_nodes.name: Shearer's independent set bound via entropy
new_nodes.description: Entropy-based bound on the number of independent sets in a graph, strengthening the naive 2^n bound using local structure.

new_nodes.name: Hypergraph container method
new_nodes.function_signature: (r-uniform hypergraph H) -> (Small collection of containers, Each independent set in some container)
new_nodes.description: Construct a small collection of 'containers' (almost-independent vertex sets) such that every independent set of the hypergraph is contained in some container.

new_nodes.name: Saxton-Thomason container theorem
new_nodes.description: For uniform hypergraphs satisfying codegree conditions, there exists a small family of containers for independent sets with controlled supersaturation.

new_nodes.name: Balogh-Morris-Samotij container theorem
new_nodes.description: An independent container theorem for hypergraphs using a supersaturation approach, yielding strong bounds on the number of independent sets.

new_nodes.name: Sum-free subsets count via containers
new_nodes.description: The number of sum-free subsets of [n] is 2^{n/2 + o(n)}, proved using the container method.

new_nodes.name: Triangle-free graph count via containers
new_nodes.description: The number of triangle-free graphs on n labelled vertices is 2^{n^2/4 + o(n^2)}, proved using the container method.

new_nodes.name: Sparse regularity method
new_nodes.function_signature: (Sparse graph with density p, Epsilon parameter) -> (Sparse epsilon-regular partition, Counting/embedding results)
new_nodes.description: Adapt Szemeredi's regularity lemma to sparse graphs with edge density p, obtaining meaningful partitions and counting lemmas relative to p.

new_nodes.name: Kohayakawa-Rodl sparse regularity lemma
new_nodes.description: Every graph satisfying an upper-uniformity condition admits an epsilon-regular partition relative to its density, extending Szemeredi regularity to sparse graphs.

new_nodes.name: Sparse counting lemma
new_nodes.description: A counting lemma for sparse epsilon-regular graphs: the number of copies of a fixed graph in a sparse regular setup matches the expected count up to a small error.

new_nodes.name: Rodl-Rucinski sparse Ramsey theorem
new_nodes.description: For any graph H and integer r, there exists a threshold p_0(n) such that for p >> p_0, every r-coloring of edges of G(n,p) a.a.s. contains a monochromatic copy of H.

new_nodes.name: Shamir-Spencer chromatic concentration
new_nodes.description: For constant p in (0,1), the chromatic number chi(G(n,p)) is concentrated on an interval of length about sqrt(n).

new_nodes.name: Off-diagonal Ramsey bound via LLL
new_nodes.description: R(3,k) >= Omega(k^2/log k) obtained via the Lovasz Local Lemma and Property B arguments.

new_nodes.name: Chromatic number lower bound via theta
new_nodes.description: chi(G) >= n/theta(G), giving a lower bound on the chromatic number using the Lovasz theta function of the complement.

new_nodes.name: 2-density of a graph
new_nodes.description: m_2(H) = max_{J subseteq H, v(J) >= 3} (e(J)-1)/(v(J)-2), the maximum 2-density over subgraphs, governing thresholds for balanced subgraph appearance.

new_nodes.name: Upper uniformity condition
new_nodes.description: A no-dense-spots condition requiring that no subgraph is significantly denser than the ambient density p, needed for sparse regularity to be meaningful.
